title: Twin Engine, Bandai Launch New Manga Platform Bibibi Comic
content: Anime planning and production company Twin Engine launched a new manga platform called Bibibi Comic with Bandai Co., Ltd. as part of their previously announced strategic partnership. Users can read titles with free tickets after completing missions, as well as one free chapter every 23 hours.
author: ANN

title: HIDIVE Expands MBS Partnership, Licenses Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime
content: AMC Global Media announced on Monday that it will extend and expand the distribution agreement between its subsidiary Sentai Filmworks and Japan's Mainichi Broadcasting System ( MBS ) in a new multi-year deal.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Adds The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten Season 2 Anime's English Dub, More Titles on Crunchyroll Manga
content: Crunchyroll Manga also added the following titles on Monday: • At Summer's End • Bocchi the Rock! • Demon Lord Exchange!! • Don't Blush Sekime-san! • East, Into The Night • From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman • KoLD8: King of the Living Dead • LAND LOCK • Magical Girl Tsubame: I Will (Not) Save The World!

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Finally Confirms Its Return After Indefinite Hiatus (But There’s a Catch)
content: Solo Leveling : Ragnarok shocked fans with the unexpected hiatus in January this year when the manhwa artist, Jin, had to be enlisted in mandatory military service. Since the light novel is written by Daul, it’s considered a spin-off rather than a direct continuation of the main story written by Chugong .
author: ComicBook

title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked Anime Casts Momoka Terasawa
content: NBC Universal revealed a new cast member for the television anime of Otsuji 's My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ( Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ) manga (the Japanese manga and anime write the English title as: My mother-in-law and sister-in-law who don't bully me.) on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Anime Reveals Trailer, 3 Cast Members for 'Chaos Breaker' Arc
content: The staff for Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation III , the third season of the Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation anime, revealed on Monday a trailer and three more cast members for the "Chaos Breaker" arc, starting with the eighth episode on August 16: The new season covers the "Eris Training Arc" storyline,…

title: HIDIVE and MBS Expand Anime Partnership With Multi-Year Exclusive Streaming Deal, Announce Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden License
content: HIDIVE and Japan’s Mainichi Broadcasting System (MBS) are expanding their anime partnership through a new multi-year output agreement. The agreement will see HIDIVE exclusively simulcast select upcoming MBS anime outside Asia over multiple seasons.
author: Anime Corner

title: Star Wars Dominates Disney+ With New Show & Proves Anime Is Perfect for the Franchise
content: Star Wars has returned to Disney+ with a new anime series that’s dominating the streaming service right now, and it’s proof that anime is the medium the franchise really needs to succeed.
author: ComicBook

title: Pui Pui Molcar Anime Gets New 5th Anniversary Special
content: The official website for Shinei Animation 's Pui Pui Molcar stop-motion anime series announced on Monday that the franchise is getting a new special to commemorate its fifth anniversary. Creator Tomoki Misato is returning to direct for the franchise for the first time since the anime's first season.
author: ANN

title: Patlabor EZY Anime's Trailer Reveals March 5 Opening, Cast for 'File 3' Movie
content: The official website for the Patlabor EZY anime project began streaming on Monday a teaser trailer for "File 3," the anime's third compilation film containing its seventh and eighth episodes. The video reveals the film's March 5 opening.
author: ANN
